explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/416: Maier and Pomerance proved V(x) = (x/log x)·exp((C+o(1))(log log log x)²) for an explicit constant C > 0. The Lean statement: 0 < answer ∧ ∃ f = o(1) such that eventually V x = x/log x · exp((answer + f x)·(log log log x)²). The o(1) is correctly encoded as an existential function tending to 0 (f =o 1), and since (log log log x)² → ∞ the constant is uniquely determined, so the answer placeholder (C = 0.8178146…) cannot be chosen degenerately. Faithful.
